ARC0742I.description: Backup CDS - start dla MCDS / BCDS / OCDS
ARC0742I.pattern: ^BACKUP FOR (?<dsid>\S+) STARTING AT (?<time>[\d:]+) ON (?<date>[\d/.]+),\s*BACKUP COPY TECHNIQUE IS (?<copy_technique>[A-Z]+)

ARC0750I.pattern: ^BACKUP FOR (?<dsid>\S+) STARTING AT (?<time>[\d:]+) ON (?<date>[\d/.]+),\s*BACKUP TECHNIQUE IS (?<jrnl_technique>\S+)

ARC0744E.description: Backup CDS - blad zbioru; linia (CONT.) = funkcje HSM HELD

ARC0745E.description: Nie mozna odczytac MHCR - backup CDS nie startuje

ARC0747E.description: Blad rename / catalog / uncatalog / locate kopii CDS
ARC0747E.pattern: ^UNABLE TO (?<operation>RENAME|CATALOG|UNCATALOG|LOCATE) DATA SET (?<dsname>\S+) DURING CDS BACKUP,\s*RC=\s*(?<rc>\d+)

ARC0748I.description: Backup CDS - ostatni udany zestaw kopii
ARC0748I.pattern: ^LAST SUCCESSFUL CDS BACKUP - SET QUALIFIER IS '(?<final_qualifier>[^']+)'

ARC0799I.description: Backup CDS przerwany - kolejka journala nie oprozniona

ARC0909E.pattern: ^(?<dsid>MCDS CONTROL|BCDS CONTROL|OCDS CONTROL|JOURNAL) DATA SET IS ABOUT\s*(?<percent>\d+)% FULL

ARC0026E.description: Journaling wylaczony - wiekszosc funkcji HSM HELD
